hero.h1: Put AI engines to work. Live in under a minute.
hero.lead: Chalyb is one dashboard for ready-made AI engines: clip your streams, run trading signals, automate your operation. Start free, test in simulation, go live when it pays.

pillars.title: Everything you need to run AI. Nothing you don't.
pillars.subtitle: Three things the platform does well, so you don't have to build any of them.

1.title: Ready-made AI engines, no build required
1.body: Pick from a growing library of engines the Chalyb team runs in production. Each one solves a specific job from day one.

bullets.1: ChalybClip turns your streams into vertical clips ready to post
bullets.2: ChalybCrypto delivers backtested crypto signals and 24/7 alerts
bullets.3: New engines ship continuously and are included in your plan

2.title: Test everything free. Go live when you're ready
2.body: Every engine runs in simulation on the free plan. When the results convince you, flip it live with one click.

bullets.1: Unlimited simulation runs on every engine
bullets.2: Pro puts one engine live, VIP puts them all live
bullets.3: Switch engines or pause any time, no lock-in

3.title: See every run. Pay only for what you use
3.body: Dashboards, execution history and a token meter come built in. It is the same tooling the Chalyb team uses on its own systems.

bullets.1: Live dashboards and full execution history
bullets.2: Monthly tokens included, top-ups never expire
bullets.3: Secure checkout with Mercado Pago, cancel any time

visuals.modeFoot: One click to switch. No redeploy, no downtime.

how.title: Up and running in three steps
how.subtitle: No sales call, no onboarding project.

1.title: Sign up and connect
1.body: Create your account with Google or email. Your workspace is ready in under a minute.

2.title: Pick and configure an engine
2.body: Choose an engine, connect your channel or exchange and set the rules. Run it in simulation first.

3.title: Get results
3.body: Clips post themselves, signals arrive in real time and every run is logged. Go live on Pro when it pays.

welcome.title: Welcome to Chalyb
welcome.body: This is your workspace. Here's the essentials in a minute — you can see it later or close it anytime.

nav.title: Your menu
nav.body: Navigate everything from here, grouped into Your account, Platform and Settings. Switch sections in one click.

engines.title: Your engines
engines.body: Under “My engines” you view, open and activate engines (ChalybClip, ChalybCrypto and more). “Live” = running; “Available” = ready to use on your plan.

tokens.title: Your token balance
tokens.body: Under “Usage” you check how many AI tokens you have left this month and your consumption. Out of tokens? Top up or upgrade.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.body: Under “Subscription” you compare Free, Pro and VIP and switch plans. “Billing” has your payments and receipts.

account.title: Your info
account.body: Under “Profile & security” you update your details, change your password and enable two-factor auth.

help.title: Need help?
help.body: “Messages” is a direct line to the Chalyb team, and “Help” has guides and support. We've got you.
